tools.description: Resolve a Greek buyer or supplier NAME to its ΑΦΜ. For when you have a name but no ΑΦΜ: get_entity, entity_counterparties and the buyer_afm/supplier_afm filters take the 9-digit number. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive; returns the closest names with their ΑΦΜ.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: What your Diavgis plan allows right now (the same for an API key and a connected account): plan, calls used this period, calls remaining, per-minute rate, page-size and pagination caps, and when the period resets. Free — this call is not counted against the quota. Useful for sizing a long job.
